originalTitle: Brent crude jumps 7%, climbs over $90 on escalating Middle East strikes
simplifiedContent: The price of oil, also known as Brent crude, increased by 7% and is now over $90. This happened because of new military actions in the Middle East, which made people worry about oil supplies. The amount of oil stored in the US is also very low, which added to these concerns and made oil prices go up. This volatility, or unpredictability, is expected to continue for a while, with prices possibly going up or down. The group that controls a lot of the world's oil production, called OPEC+, plans to keep producing the same amount of oil for now.

originalTitle: J&K Bank Q1 profit slips 13% as higher provisions hit earnings
simplifiedContent: Jammu and Kashmir Bank made less money in the first quarter, with a profit of Rs 424 crore, which is 12.6% lower than before. This happened because the bank had to set aside more money for potential losses, which reduced its earnings. Even though the bank had more loans and deposits, and its assets were healthier, its profit still went down. As a result, the bank's stock price fell by almost 13%, which means the value of the company's shares decreased. This decline in profit and stock price might be important for investors who own or are considering buying shares of the bank.

originalTitle: Star Health Insurance Q1 Results: Profit jumps 25% to Rs 550 crore
simplifiedContent: Star Health Insurance just released its quarterly results, and the company made a profit of Rs 550 crore, which is 25% more than it made last year. This increase in profit is largely due to a rise in total income, which grew to Rs 4,471 crore from Rs 3,990 crore. The company also saw a significant increase in the amount of money it collected from premiums, with a 19% jump to Rs 4,287 crore. This is important because it shows that the company is doing well and making more money, which could be good for investors. The company also settled a large number of claims, with a high settlement ratio of 91%, which suggests that it is taking care of its customers.

originalTitle: Cupid makes additional $5 million investment in GII Healthcare platform
simplifiedContent: Cupid, a company, has put an extra $5 million into a healthcare business called GII Healthcare Investment Limited. This means Cupid believes the healthcare sector will continue to grow and wants to be a part of it. The money for this investment came from Cupid's own funds, showing they are committed to GII's plans for the future. This investment is important because it shows Cupid is serious about being involved in the healthcare sector. By doing this, Cupid is strengthening its connection to GII, although we don't know exactly how big of a stake they now own.

originalTitle: Oil prices rebound, jump 8% as Trump warns Iran after attacks on US forces; Brent nears $90
simplifiedContent: The price of oil has gone up by 8% because of concerns about a potential conflict between the US and Iran. This happened after the US president, Trump, warned Iran that there would be consequences for attacking US forces. As a result, the price of Brent crude oil rose to $84.58 and US crude oil rose to $85.53. This matters because when oil prices rise, it can affect the stock market and the economy. The increase in oil prices is due to worries that the conflict could disrupt the supply of oil, which is a crucial resource.

originalTitle: Oil prices surge 6% amid fresh escalation in West Asia
simplifiedContent: The price of oil has suddenly gone up by 6% due to new tensions in West Asia. This is a problem for India because it buys almost 90% of the oil it needs from other countries. If oil prices stay higher by just $1 per barrel for a year, India will have to pay an extra ₹18,000 crore to buy the oil it needs. This is a big deal because it will increase India's expenses, which could affect its economy. This surge in oil prices is something to watch closely, especially for a country like India that relies heavily on imported oil.
